patterns.name: Remote Lookup Or Expression Injection In Request Headers And Parameters
patterns.basis: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) attacks by Khonsari and Night Sky ransomware operators planted nested JNDI lookups in User-Agent and other headers, and Confluence OGNL injection (CVE-2022-26134) used the same request-side pattern (T1190).

patterns.name: Known Vulnerability Scanner And Mass Probe Traces
patterns.basis: Mass scanning for Citrix ADC (CVE-2019-19781) and Exchange ProxyLogon (CVE-2021-26855) began within days of disclosure, and Hafnium probed many Exchange servers before exploiting them (T1190).

patterns.name: Exploit Request Followed By Web Shell Or Command Execution
patterns.basis: Hafnium chained Exchange CVE-2021-26855 and CVE-2021-27065 to drop China Chopper web shells, and Mirai botnet operators used Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965) to write a JSP web shell and run commands (T1190).
